description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
When Woodfall Primus enters, it triggers, destroying a noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
